knowledge:
- key_parameters: regionsSeq=A DNAStringSet object containing the genomic sequences of interest, which must all be of equal length ;; patterns=A character vector of oligonucleotides or consensus sequences (using IUPAC ambiguity codes) to search for ;; seqOrder=An integer vector specifying the order of sequences (e.g., sorted by a metadata feature like promoter width) for the density map ;; flankUp=Integer specifying the upstream flanking distance from the reference point ;; flankDown=Integer specifying the downstream flanking distance from the reference point ;; color=Character string specifying the color palette (e.g., "blue", "cyan", "pink", "purple", "red") ;; nBin=An integer vector of length 2 specifying horizontal and vertical binning for density calculation ;; bandWidth=A numeric vector of length 2 specifying the standard deviation of the 2D Gaussian kernel along the x and y axes ;; useMulticore=Logical to enable parallel processing on Unix-like platforms ;; nrCores=Integer specifying the number of cores to use for parallel processing ;; motifPWM=A position weight matrix (PWM) representing a transcription factor binding motif ;; minScore=A character string (e.g., "90%") or numeric value specifying the minimum threshold score for motif matches ;; smoothingWindow=Integer specifying the window size for smoothing average occurrence profiles
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation.
- when_to_use: Use when you have a set of genomic regions (e.g., promoters, enhancers, ChIP-seq peaks) centered at a common reference point (e.g., TSS, peak summit) and want to visualize how specific sequence patterns, IUPAC consensus sequences, or PWM-defined motifs are spatially distributed and how this distribution correlates with a continuous or categorical sequence feature (e.g., expression level, peak width).
- pitfalls: All input sequences in regionsSeq must have the exact same width. If flanking regions fall outside chromosome boundaries during sequence extraction, they must be trimmed or removed prior to plotting to avoid errors or unequal sequence lengths. Parallel processing (useMulticore = TRUE) is only supported on Unix-like platforms.

workflows.name: oligonucleotide_and_consensus_density
workflows.intent: Extract genomic sequences around a reference point, sort them by a feature, and visualize oligonucleotide or consensus sequence densities and average profiles.
input: coordinates.txt (tab-delimited file containing genomic coordinates and associated features)
genome_assembly (a BSgenome package corresponding to the organism's genome)
workflows.stages: 1. Create GRanges of reference positions with associated metadata ;; 2. Define flanking regions of equal width using promoters() ;; 3. Extract genomic sequences using getSeq() ;; 4. Plot dinucleotide or consensus density maps using plotPatternDensityMap() ;; 5. Plot average oligonucleotide profiles using plotPatternOccurrenceAverage()
workflows.code:
zebrafishPromotersTSS <- GRanges(seqnames = zebrafishPromoters24h$chr,
            ranges = IRanges(start = zebrafishPromoters24h$dominantTSS, 
            end = zebrafishPromoters24h$dominantTSS), 
            strand = zebrafishPromoters24h$strand, 
            interquantileWidth = zebrafishPromoters24h$interquantileWidth, 
            seqlengths = seqlengths(Drerio))
zebrafishPromotersTSSflank <- promoters(zebrafishPromotersTSS, upstream = 400, 
                                        downstream = 800)
zebrafishPromotersTSSflankSeq <- getSeq(Drerio, zebrafishPromotersTSSflank)
plotPatternDensityMap(regionsSeq = zebrafishPromotersTSSflankSeq, 
            patterns = c("AA", "TA", "CG", "GC"), 
            seqOrder = order(zebrafishPromotersTSSflank$interquantileWidth), 
            flankUp = 400, flankDown = 800, color = "blue")
plotPatternDensityMap(regionsSeq = zebrafishPromotersTSSflankSeq, 
            patterns = c("AA", "TA", "CG", "GC"), 
            seqOrder = order(zebrafishPromotersTSSflank$interquantileWidth),
            flankUp = 400, flankDown = 800, useMulticore = TRUE, nrCores = 4)
plotPatternDensityMap(regionsSeq = zebrafishPromotersTSSflankSeq, 
            patterns = c("WW", "SS"), 
            seqOrder = order(zebrafishPromotersTSSflank$interquantileWidth), 
            flankUp = 400, flankDown = 800, color = "cyan", labelCol = "white")
sIdx <- zebrafishPromotersTSSflank$interquantileWidth <= 9
bIdx <- zebrafishPromotersTSSflank$interquantileWidth > 9
par(mfrow = c(1,2), mar = c(4.5,4,1,1))
plotPatternOccurrenceAverage(regionsSeq = zebrafishPromotersTSSflankSeq[sIdx], 
            patterns = c("WW", "SS"), flankUp = 400, flankDown = 800, 
            smoothingWindow = 3, color = c("red3", "blue3"), cex.axis = 0.9)
plotPatternOccurrenceAverage(regionsSeq = zebrafishPromotersTSSflankSeq[bIdx], 
            patterns = c("WW", "SS"), flankUp = 400, flankDown = 800, 
            smoothingWindow = 3, color = c("red3", "blue3"), cex.axis = 0.9)
zebrafishPromotersTSSflank <- promoters(zebrafishPromotersTSS, upstream = 200, 
                                        downstream = 200)
zebrafishPromotersTSSflankSeq <- getSeq(Drerio, zebrafishPromotersTSSflank)
plotPatternDensityMap(regionsSeq = zebrafishPromotersTSSflankSeq, 
            patterns = c("TATAWAWR", "YWTWTATA"), 
            seqOrder = order(zebrafishPromotersTSSflank$interquantileWidth), 
            flankUp = 200, flankDown = 200, nBin = c(400, 10000), 
            bandWidth = c(1,6), color = "pink", addPatternLabel = FALSE)
plotPatternDensityMap(regionsSeq = zebrafishPromotersTSSflankSeq, 
            patterns = c("RGGMGGR", "YCCKCCY"), 
            seqOrder = order(zebrafishPromotersTSSflank$interquantileWidth), 
            flankUp = 200, flankDown = 200, nBin = c(400, 10000), 
            bandWidth = c(1,6), color = "purple", addPatternLabel = FALSE)

workflows.name: motif_scanning_and_density
workflows.intent: Scan genomic sequences with a Position Weight Matrix (PWM) to visualize motif density, scanning scores, and average occurrence profiles.
input: coordinates.txt (tab-delimited file containing genomic coordinates and associated features)
genome_assembly (a BSgenome package corresponding to the organism's genome)
pwm_matrix.RData (R object containing the Position Weight Matrix of the motif)
workflows.stages: 1. Create GRanges of reference positions with associated metadata ;; 2. Define flanking regions of equal width using promoters() ;; 3. Extract genomic sequences using getSeq() ;; 4. Plot motif density maps above a threshold using plotMotifDensityMap() ;; 5. Plot a heatmap of PWM scanning scores along sequences using plotMotifScanScores() ;; 6. Plot average motif occurrence profiles using plotMotifOccurrenceAverage() ;; 7. Retrieve raw motif hits using motifScanHits() or scanning scores using motifScanScores()
workflows.code:
zebrafishPromotersTSS <- GRanges(seqnames = zebrafishPromoters24h$chr,
            ranges = IRanges(start = zebrafishPromoters24h$dominantTSS, 
            end = zebrafishPromoters24h$dominantTSS), 
            strand = zebrafishPromoters24h$strand, 
            interquantileWidth = zebrafishPromoters24h$interquantileWidth, 
            seqlengths = seqlengths(Drerio))
zebrafishPromotersTSSflank <- promoters(zebrafishPromotersTSS, upstream = 200, 
                                        downstream = 200)
zebrafishPromotersTSSflankSeq <- getSeq(Drerio, zebrafishPromotersTSSflank)
data(TBPpwm)
plotMotifDensityMap(regionsSeq = zebrafishPromotersTSSflankSeq, 
            motifPWM = TBPpwm, minScore = "90%", 
            seqOrder = order(zebrafishPromotersTSSflank$interquantileWidth),
            flankUp = 200, flankDown = 200, color = "red")
plotMotifScanScores(regionsSeq = zebrafishPromotersTSSflankSeq, 
            motifPWM = TBPpwm,
            seqOrder = order(zebrafishPromotersTSSflank$interquantileWidth),
            flankUp = 200, flankDown = 200)
sIdx <- zebrafishPromotersTSSflank$interquantileWidth <= 9
bIdx <- zebrafishPromotersTSSflank$interquantileWidth > 9
plotMotifOccurrenceAverage(regionsSeq = zebrafishPromotersTSSflankSeq[sIdx], 
            motifPWM = TBPpwm, minScore = "90%", flankUp = 200, flankDown = 200, 
            smoothingWindow = 3, color = c("red3"), cex.axis = 0.9)
plotMotifOccurrenceAverage(regionsSeq = zebrafishPromotersTSSflankSeq[bIdx], 
            motifPWM = TBPpwm, minScore = "90%", flankUp = 200, flankDown = 200, 
            smoothingWindow = 3, color = c("blue3"), add = TRUE)
legend("topright", legend = c("sharp", "broad"), col = c("red3", "blue3"), 
bty = "n", lwd = 1)
motifOccurrence <- motifScanHits(regionsSeq = 
            zebrafishPromotersTSSflankSeq[1:50], 
            motifPWM = TBPpwm, minScore = "90%", seqOrder = 
            order(zebrafishPromotersTSSflank$interquantileWidth[1:50]))
scanScores <- motifScanScores(regionsSeq = zebrafishPromotersTSSflankSeq[1:50], 
            motifPWM = TBPpwm, seqOrder = 
            order(zebrafishPromotersTSSflank$interquantileWidth[1:50]))
